title: Playboy's Blondes Brunettes & Redheads 1985 Newsstand Special Edition Vintage
conditionDescription: Covers bright with no tears; spine intact. Light toning and small marks along the edges, light corner wear. Complete. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy's Blondes, Brunettes & Redheads - 1985 newsstand special edition, "Variations on a Theme", 112 pages. Original $3.95 cover price (Canada $4.50, U.K. 3.50 pounds).

Cover: a blonde, a brunette and a redhead in matching blue bikinis.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
